display_name: DURA 源微扰响应与参数梯度诊断
description: 评估源合成微扰响应损失与源 IQ 保护损失对同一修正网络参数的梯度关系。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: First 32 source physical IDs x 3 fixed views, four 1% source-clean-derived IQ perturbations

permissions.claim_scope: Small source synthetic-response and parameter-gradient diagnostics only; no target, identity or general performance claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA and fixed 117062-parameter source correction initialization; no optimization
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact DURA source checkpoint, deterministic source context and matching source initialization/fit IDs; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ context are F/TX/V/target free
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 32 IDs and four predefined perturbations; no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: source response losses and parameter-gradient cosine/norm ratio

rows.method: Compare source guard and synthetic response parameter gradients at fixed initialization
rows.purpose: Assess source gradient compatibility for a prospective physically perturbed recovery objective
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source correction initialization 2026110612; deterministic first 32 source IDs; no new random draw
rows.scenario: 32 source IDs x three fixed simulated views
expected_artifacts: result.json: source response losses and parameter-gradient cosine/norm ratio

notes: Four directions are source clean-derived conjugate, amplitude cubic, phase slope and local difference, each 1% relative RMS.
Perturbations are sent through DURA estimated action, added to current received IQ, then full DURA is recomputed.
Gradient cosine/norm ratio is at a fixed untrained correction initialization, averaged across the three equal-size batches.
No optimizer, weight saving, F/TX/V/target; synthetic response is not transmitter identity or target performance.
